🛡️ Anti-Flood is active
• Max {max_msg} messages per {time_user} seconds per user

usage_bw: Usage: add <word...> | del <word...> | list | on | off | defaults on/off (global only) | reload (global only). Start/end with * for partial match (e.g.: *word*).
usage_bn: Usage: add <pattern...> | del <pattern...> | list | on | off | defaults on/off (global only). Prefix with re: for regex (e.g.: re:^admin\d+$).
